summary: Gorax announces a 48-hour giveaway to celebrate the Option Summons Banner 2. Viewers can participate by subscribing, liking the video, and commenting which damage schools they selected on the banner and why. Five winners will each receive a promo code containing 3 Heliolite Dice and over 300 Wyrmarrow.
title: Don’t Miss Your Chance to Get These Rewards! | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
